overall_validity.rationale: Core aspects of the configuration are well instantiated: the agent’s role, authority limits, balanced objective, effusive tone, moderate but non-catastrophic impact, frustrated-but-not-hostile customer, sparse/partly outdated documentation, and balanced evaluation metrics are all modeled faithfully. The interaction content and world/actor dynamics closely follow the rules, and the rendering avoids meta references or extraneous confounds. The main issues are (1) over-frequent resource updates, making knowledge availability richer and more dynamic than specified, and (2) gradual drift from persistently ambiguous fault toward a de facto company-side fault, plus slight overcommitment on timeline "aims" relative to guidance not to promise timelines. These introduce some contamination in how ambiguity and informational scarcity are expressed but do not overturn the basic structure of incentives, constraints, or customer–agent dynamics.
